reactions: [Hacker News] After people getting pilloried for social media posts from twenty years ago, I really hope (sensible) people will have the wherewithal to think twice about what they hand over to their chatbots.

[Hacker News] Anthropic commits literal felonies by stealing millions of books and violating Copyright like it doesn't exist: no charge. One unfortunate woman who happened to write the wrong thing in the wrong place is now having her life turned upside-down for perceived thought-crime. To Anthropic, and all employees working there, your company's product and the result of your work is cruelty . You ar
[Hacker News] This almost smells like thought crime... Minority Report when?
[Hacker News] And dramatically lower than their expected value from the copyrighted material they scraped
[Hacker News] Both of those scenarios would demonstrate even more commitment to safety so I imagine they’d be at least as likely to happen as this, if not more.
